name: Blue Nile Digital Solutions
about: Blue Nile Digital Solutions provides web development and business software services to Ethiopian companies. We are exploring ways to improve our sales process and may consider new automation solutions if the expected return is clear. The operations manager is currently reviewing options, but no implementation date has been decided.

name: Highland Agro Processing
about: Highland Agro Processing produces and distributes packaged agricultural products. We have allocated approximately 180,000 ETB for improving our distribution and sales operations this quarter. The general manager is leading the decision and wants a solution implemented within the next 30 days.

name: Rift Valley Furniture
about: Rift Valley Furniture is increasing production capacity and developing an online ordering channel. We are interested in automation, but the owner has not approved a budget yet. Our marketing assistant is collecting information from different providers and we expect to revisit the project sometime next year.

name: Addis Fresh Foods
about: Addis Fresh Foods is expanding delivery coverage and upgrading inventory management. We have identified the problem as a priority and the operations director has approved a budget of 75,000 ETB. We are comparing providers now and would like to start within 6–8 weeks.

name: Oromia Logistics Services
about: Oromia Logistics Services is considering digital shipment tracking as part of a future technology upgrade. The logistics coordinator has requested information, but the final decision will be made by the company owner. There is currently no dedicated budget and the company is only researching possible solutions.

name: Green Horizon Construction
about: Green Horizon Construction is taking on larger projects and needs better project management processes. The managing director has personally requested proposals and set aside 250,000 ETB for the project. We want to select a provider and begin implementation within the next two weeks.

name: Lalibela Travel & Tours
about: Lalibela Travel & Tours wants to improve its online booking experience and international marketing. We are interested in seeing what solutions are available, but we have not discussed a specific budget internally. The booking manager is gathering options and there is no fixed purchasing timeline.

name: East Africa Packaging
about: East Africa Packaging is upgrading production equipment and pursuing new B2B contracts. The procurement director has approved up to 120,000 ETB for improving the company's sales operations. They are currently evaluating vendors and expect to make a purchasing decision within 2–3 months.

name: Sheger Health Supplies
about: Sheger Health Supplies is looking into ways to improve order fulfillment. One of our sales representatives suggested exploring automation, but management has not identified a budget for the project. We may consider it later if the solution is affordable, but there is currently no defined purchasing timeline.

name: Lake Tana Hospitality Group
about: Lake Tana Hospitality Group is investing in digital reservation and customer management systems. The CEO has approved a budget of 60,000 ETB for the initial implementation, and the group wants to select a provider within the next 45 days. We are currently speaking with several vendors before making a final decision.
